corpus.overlap_policy: exclude all downstream complete structures; validation wins SSL duplicates; shared ions allowed

protocol: Fresh independent initialization at each nested data scale. Three complete passes; final third-pass encoder is the prespecified scale-comparison checkpoint. No old pretrained results or scratch fits are reused. Same frozen split and five downstream fitting seeds. Increasing both unique data and optimizer updates; not an isolated data-only effect. Main transfer measure: validation standardized MSE per property; shared candidate ranked by mean across three properties and all five seeds. Keep per-property regressions visible; the full corpus is trained regardless of interim ranking.
